scientific_integrity: Proof and finite verifier accompany the theorem; experimental enumerations are corroborative only; all mathematical limits and uninspected primary material are identified.
scientific_limitations: The explicitly new assertion concerns non-field truncated rings of length at least two; the field specialization is previously known. The proof covers all prime-power residue fields, all ranks and lengths. General ring extensions and a closed count of every submodule are not claimed. Publication priority is best-knowledge and the 2024 mod-prime-power Heisenberg paper was available only at abstract level; independently validated proof is not claimed.
title: Chermak–Delgado submodule lattices of truncated-ring Heisenberg groups
